description: EU VAT & IBAN/BIC Validator API (vat): Validate IBANs, BIC/SWIFT codes, and EU/UK VAT numbers with live EU VIES lookup. (Endpoint: POST /v1/eu-vat-iban/vat)

vat_number.description: EU VAT number including 2-letter country prefix (spaces/dashes allowed).

verify_vies.description: Whether to query EU VIES (with KV cache & graceful degradation). Defaults to true.

name: tinplate_eu_vat_iban_vat
